rules.expected_window: One sufficient canonical contiguous slice. Other exact slices are acceptable only when independently sufficient and preserving every required fragment and qualifier; matching a positive page alone does not pass.
rules.negative: No primary reference. INSUFFICIENT includes partial relation, wrong owner or condition, unresolved question and structurally incomplete evidence; it is not an entailment probability.
rules.aliases: Only source-attested unambiguous acronym/full-name pairs. No external acronym knowledge.
rules.history: Bounded prior user questions only. Multiple unresolved entities cannot be chosen using which source happened to retrieve.
rules.polarity: A negative operating condition is part of the question and must not be dropped.
rules.numbers: Requested model, load, count or completeness numbers must be preserved.
rules.safety: These sources are deliberately invented; this fixture does not authorize network calls, runtime enablement, schema changes or relaxed release thresholds.
